parties: Ola Electric Mobility Limited vs. Two Unnamed Suppliers
headline: Ola Electric: NSE Seeks Clarification on Reports of Two Suppliers Filing NCLT Over Dues
sum: The National Stock Exchange sought clarification from Ola Electric Mobility on press reports that two suppliers are moving to the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) over unpaid dues. The company's response to the stock exchange inquiry was pending as of 7 July 2026.
detail: The NSE issued a news verification query to Ola Electric following media reports of two suppliers threatening or initiating NCLT proceedings over alleged payment defaults. The exchange sought the company's response on the accuracy and status of these claims. As of the reporting date, Ola Electric had not yet responded to the NSE clarification demand. NCLT filings by suppliers would constitute a material event for a listed company and may trigger insolvency or supply-chain disruption risks. The incident reflects broader working-capital stress in India's EV sector post-2025.
